title: 第461章 兽与人第460章 第三个对手
slug: 我的灵根等级怎么是负的
content_zh:
红王揭开秘密时，格雷维斯感到无比的紧张和震惊。这将彻底改变他和白猿之间的关系。白猿极其强大，在帝国享有崇高的地位，而格雷维斯则几乎是个无名小卒。
是的，格拉维斯可以算作女皇的培育者，但这样的人到底有多少呢？格拉维斯也不知道，但他确信帝国里的培育者数量肯定比二级皇帝还要多。而且，凭借女皇的影响力，她可以随意获得新的伴侣，但想要新的二级皇帝却没那么容易。
这意味着，事态已经演变成一种远不值钱的资源威胁到帝国极其宝贵的资源。单是他所构成的威胁，或许就足以让他丧命。那么，红王为何决定现在就说出他的秘密？为何要拿自己的赏金冒险？
与此同时，白猿意识到了几件事。他清楚地记得几分钟前，格拉维斯曾告诉他，如果试图接近矿石，就必须派另一只野兽过来。当时，白猿完全不明白格拉维斯为什么要派另一只野兽过来。毕竟，白猿的强大足以轻易将他消灭。然而，随着新信息的披露，一切都说得通了！
格雷维斯希望他再派一只野兽过来，因为格雷维斯可以杀了他。如果格雷维斯真的绝望到想要接近矿石，那就意味着他已经陷入了无路可逃的境地。到那时，格雷维斯甚至可能会决定杀了他。毕竟，他已经认为自己注定要死了。
白猿目视着格拉维斯。两人之间现在相距四十多公里，这意味着白猿刚好进入格拉维斯的神识范围。这样的距离，至少能让格拉维斯有机会思考。在这样的距离下，白猿根本无法杀死他。
白猿也意识到了彼此之间复杂的威胁，两人只需一个念头，就能将对方击杀。这种情况在白猿所知的范围内，从未发生过。通常情况下，实力相近的异兽，不可能瞬间将对方击杀。
唯一可能的情况是，其中一头野兽的力量比另一头强大数倍。然而，这导致威胁不可能同时发生。毕竟，其中一头野兽的力量远超另一头。
“你为什么不早点告诉我们？”白猿向格拉维斯问道。
格雷维斯眯着眼睛看着远处的白猿。“因为只要你没有意识到我的威胁，你就没有理由杀我，也就没有理由杀你。如果我杀了你，女皇会杀我；但如果你杀了我，看在你和女皇的关系份上，你不会死。”
格雷维斯冷冷地、威胁地解释了这一切。形势已经变了，他必须明确表示，如果白猿决定攻击他，他不会犹豫。
最糟糕的情况，就是白猿不相信他，为了试探而攻击他。那样的话，要么格拉维斯死，要么白猿死，而白猿死也会导致格拉维斯的死亡。
白猿努力理解着眼前的状况。兽类之间的关系简单直接。强大的兽类要么无视弱小的兽类，要么让其加入自己的部落，要么将其杀死。兽类之间很少有复杂的关系。政治更像是人类的事情。
“只要你敢试探我，我就会死，不管我杀不杀你。只要你需要做出选择，我的生命就完了。所以现在我不能告诉你，也不能让你靠近我。”格雷维斯威胁道。他必须阻止这只白猿做出任何尝试！
令人惊讶的是，白猿只是用手指按了按鼻梁，一脸沮丧。他对整个情况的应对比格拉维斯想象的要轻松得多。
“格雷维斯，”白猿沮丧地叹了口气，问道，“你为什么要把事情搞得这么复杂？”
“因为确实如此，”格雷维斯说道。
“不是。”白猿又叹了口气，“你是我皇后的夥伴，我若杀了你，便是践踏我皇后的尊严。我们处境相同，只要有一人动手，两人都会死。所以，我为什么要杀你？”白猿解释道。
格雷维斯的疑惑和谨慎丝毫未减。“通常情况下，我会因为你对雷的亲和力而相信你，但这种事我可不敢拿自己的生命做赌注。”
“你觉得我为什么要揭露你的秘密？”红王突然问格拉维斯。“因为我认识大长老和皇后。他说的是实话。他不可能就这么杀了你。所以，既然你和他地位相似，我决定揭露你的秘密。”

“如果有人不知道别人能瞬间置自己于死地，他们就无法获得做出明智决定所需的全部信息，”红王说道。“这难道不是你还在部落的时候说过的吗？我从我的一些士兵那里听到过，我觉得这真是个不错的道理。”
格拉维斯没有思考这些话，只是冷笑一声。“朋友之间就是这样。我这里谁也不认识，就这么把我的命交给他们，未免幼稚又愚蠢。”格拉维斯说道。
砰！
突然，皇后怒不可遏，一手拍打王座。“荒谬！”她怒吼道。“你和大长老同属一个帝国！你怎么敢说你们不是朋友！？”她怒不可遏。
格雷维斯并没有被这突如其来的爆发吓倒。他已经背水一战了。“这么说，女王陛下，您的帝国里没有别有用心、图谋不轨的家伙了？”格雷维斯问道。
“当然有！”女皇立刻自信满满地回答。“可是，因为极少数心怀叵测的懦夫而不给予你的战友应有的信任，这是对他们的不尊重！我的帝国绝不会允许这样的事情发生！”
格雷维斯觉得这情况有点奇怪。女皇才刚刚承认帝国里有心机重重的弱者，却又主张要信任所有人。这不是自找麻烦吗？
“然而，”格雷维斯大声反驳道，“信任所有人，就等于给这群阴谋家留下了后路。如果所有人都信任他们，他们就能利用大家的信任为自己谋利！”
“那就说明你实力不够！”皇后吼道。“实力就是一切，如果一些心怀鬼胎的懦夫能杀了你，那只能说明你实力不够！阴谋家的道路永远走不上巅峰！所以，只要你登上了顶峰，他们又能把你怎么样呢？”
这下，格拉维斯有些愣住了。对了！他怎么突然忘了权力就是一切？他不是跟河部族所有人说过吗？他不是反复说过，在至高无上的权力面前，阴谋诡计毫无价值吗？
格拉维斯也忘了，这些是野兽，而不是人类。诡计多端的人类多如牛毛，诡计多端的野兽却极其罕见。事实上，格拉维斯只见过一种可以算作撒谎和欺骗的野兽：希拉。他从未见过任何与她类似的野兽。
格雷维斯沉默不语，陷入沉思。“我是否背叛了我教给河族的那些东西？”格雷维斯自问。“在力量面前，一切阴谋诡计都毫无意义。我不是告诉过所有人吗？然而现在，一旦我被更强大的野兽包围，我又回到了之前警告大家的那种心态。”
格雷维斯沉默了几秒钟，望着地平线。令人惊讶的是，女皇也保持了沉默。现在女皇知道，如果格雷维斯不同意，他不会有所保留。从她所见来看，装腔作势似乎也不符合他的性格。
随着时间的推移，格雷维斯的感觉开始变得更糟。
“我是个伪君子，”格雷维斯厌恶地想。“我曾经瞧不起辛西娅的虚伪。可现在，我却落入了同样的陷阱。我言行不一。”
几秒钟后，格拉维斯叹了口气，转身面向骄傲之山。然后，他俯下上身，向骄傲之山鞠躬行礼。“我犯了一个错误。我忘记了权力就是一切，开始图谋不轨。”
“我过去常说权力就是一切，瞧不起那些图谋不轨的畜生。如今，我却变成了那样的畜生。感谢女王陛下，让我认清了自己的错误。”格雷维斯缓缓而真诚地说道。
皇后沉默了几秒钟，其他野兽也不敢吭声。这整个局面远远超出了他们的承受能力，他们只能尽量保持距离。这是大长老、皇后和她的新伴侣之间的事，与他们无关。
几秒钟后，女皇皱起眉头，看向格雷维斯。
“别这么奇怪！”
content_en:
Graves was extremely nervous and shocked when the Red King revealed his secret. This will completely change his relationship with the White Ape. The White Ape is extremely powerful and holds a high status in the empire, while Graves is almost a nobody.
Yes, Gravis can be counted as the Queen's breeder, but how many such people are there? Graves didn't know either, but he was sure that there must be more breeders in the empire than the second-level emperors. Moreover, with the queen's influence, she can obtain new partners at will, but it is not so easy to get a new second-level emperor.
This means that the situation has evolved into a resource that is far less valuable and threatens the empire's extremely valuable resources. The threat he posed alone might have been enough to get him killed. So why has the Red King decided to reveal his secret now? Why risk your bounty?
At the same time, White Ape realized several things. He distinctly remembered Gravis telling him a few minutes earlier that if he tried to get close to the ore, he would have to send another beast. At that time, the white ape had no idea why Graves would send another beast. After all, the White Ape is powerful enough to easily destroy him. However, with the new information revealed, it all makes sense!
Graves wished he would send another beast over because Graves could kill him. If Graves is really desperate enough to get close to the ore, it means that he has fallen into a situation with no way out. At that point, Graves might even decide to kill him. After all, he already believed he was doomed.
The white ape stared at Gravis. The distance between the two is now more than 40 kilometers, which means that the white ape has just entered the range of Gravis's consciousness. This distance at least gives Gravis a chance to think. At such a distance, the white ape could not kill him at all.
White Ape is also aware of the complex threats between them. The two of them can kill each other with just a thought. This has never happened to White Ape's knowledge. Under normal circumstances, beasts with similar strength cannot kill each other instantly.
The only possibility is that one of the beasts is several times more powerful than the other. However, this makes it impossible for threats to occur simultaneously. After all, one beast is far more powerful than the other.
"Why didn't you tell us earlier?" White Ape asked Gravis.
Graves squinted his eyes and looked at the white ape in the distance. "Because as long as you are not aware of my threat, you have no reason to kill me, and there is no reason to kill you. If I kill you, the Queen will kill me; but if you kill me, for the sake of your relationship with the Queen, you will not die."
Graves explained it all coldly and menacingly. The situation had changed and he had to make it clear that he would not hesitate if the White Ape decided to attack him.
The worst case scenario is that the white ape doesn't believe him and attacks him just to test him. In that case, either Graves dies or the White Ape dies, and the death of the White Ape will also lead to the death of Graves.
Bai Yuan tried hard to understand the situation in front of him. The relationship between beasts is simple and direct. Strong beasts either ignore weak beasts, let them join their tribe, or kill them. Animals rarely have complex relationships with each other. Politics is more of a human thing.
"As long as you dare to test me, I will die, whether I kill you or not. As long as you need to make a choice, my life will be over. So now I can't tell you, and I can't let you get close to me." Graves threatened. He had to stop the white ape from trying anything!
Surprisingly, White Ape just pressed the bridge of his nose with his finger, looking frustrated. He took the whole situation much more lightly than Graves expected.
"Graves," Bai Yuan sighed in frustration and asked, "Why do you want to make things so complicated?"
"Because it is," Graves said.
"No. Bai Yuan sighed again, "You are my queen's partner. If I kill you, I will trample on my queen's dignity." We are in the same situation. If one of us takes action, both of us will die. So, why should I kill you? "Bai Yuan explained.
Graves' doubts and caution remained unabated. “Normally, I would trust you because of your affinity for Ray, but I wouldn’t dare risk my life on something like this. "
"Why do you think I want to reveal your secret? "The Red King suddenly asked Graves. "Because I know the great elder and the queen. He told the truth. There's no way he could just kill you. So, since you are of similar status to him, I decided to reveal your secret. "
"If someone doesn't know that someone else can kill them in an instant, they don't have all the information they need to make an informed decision," Red King said. “Isn’t this what you said when you were still in the tribe? I heard that from some of my fellow soldiers and I thought it was a really good idea. "
Graves didn't think about these words and just sneered. “That’s how it is between friends. I don't know anyone here, so it would be childish and stupid to trust them with my life. "Graves said.
Bang!
Suddenly, the queen became furious and slapped the throne with one hand. "Absurd! "She roared angrily. "You and the Great Elder belong to the same empire! How dare you say you are not friends! ? ” she was furious.
Graves was not frightened by this sudden outburst. He's already fighting against the odds. “So, Your Majesty, there are no people with ulterior motives or evil intentions in your empire? "Graves asked.
"Of course! "The Queen immediately replied confidently. "However, not giving your comrades the due trust because of a very small number of cowards with ulterior motives is disrespectful to them! My empire will never allow such a thing to happen! "
Graves found this situation a bit strange. The Queen had just admitted that there were scheming weaklings in the empire, but she advocated trusting everyone. Isn't this asking for trouble?
“However,” Graves retorted loudly, “trusting everyone is tantamount to leaving a way out for these conspirators. If everyone trusts them, they can use everyone's trust to their advantage! "
"That means you are not strong enough! "The Queen roared. "Strength is everything. If some cowards with evil intentions can kill you, it only means that you are not strong enough! The path of a conspirator will never reach the top! So once you get to the top, what can they do to you? "
At this time, Graves was a little stunned. That’s right! How come he suddenly forgot that power is everything? Didn't he tell everyone in the River Tribe? Didn’t he repeatedly say that conspiracy is worthless in the face of supreme power?
Gravis also forgot that these were beasts, not humans. There are many scheming humans, but scheming beasts are extremely rare. In fact, Gravis has only ever seen one beast that qualifies as lying and deceitful: Sheila. He had never seen any beast like her.
Graves was silent, lost in thought. "Have I betrayed what I taught RiverClan? "Graves asked himself. "In the face of strength, all conspiracies and tricks are meaningless. Didn't I tell everyone? Now, however, once I'm surrounded by stronger beasts, I'm back to the mentality I warned everyone about before. "
Graves was silent for a few seconds, looking at the horizon. Surprisingly, the Queen also remained silent. The Queen now knew that if Graves disagreed, he would not hold back. From what she saw, posturing didn't seem to be out of character for him either.
As time went on, Graves began to feel worse.
"I'm a hypocrite," GrayWeiss thought in disgust. "I used to look down on Cynthia's hypocrisy. But now, I have fallen into the same trap. My words and deeds are not consistent."
After a few seconds, Gravis sighed and turned back to Pride Mountain. Then he leaned forward and bowed to the mountain of pride. "I made a mistake. I forgot that power is everything and started to do evil."
"I used to say that power is everything, and I looked down on those beasts with evil intentions. Now, I have become such a beast. Thank you Her Majesty the Queen for making me realize my mistakes." Graves said slowly and sincerely.
The queen was silent for a few seconds, and the other beasts did not dare to say a word. This whole situation was far more than they could handle, and all they could do was try to keep their distance. This is a matter between the Great Elder, the Queen and her new partner, and has nothing to do with them.
After a few seconds, the Queen frowned and looked at Graves.
"Don't be so weird!"
